n072e2bfc17.headline: Resolute Mining buys Ivory Coast projects from AngloGold Ashanti
n072e2bfc17.summary: Resolute Mining has agreed to buy two gold projects in Ivory Coast from AngloGold Ashanti for $150 million in cash, plus a royalty award and transfer of some mining assets.
n072e2bfc17.why: Gold miners acquire and divest projects to manage reserves and growth, and gold prices shape the value of such assets. AngloGold Ashanti is a large gold producer listed in New York and Johannesburg.

n5a6f0edb8c.headline: Korea clinches $18b Czech nuclear plant deal
n5a6f0edb8c.summary: Korea has secured an $18 billion contract to build two nuclear reactors in the Czech Republic. It is Korea's first nuclear reactor export in 16 years.
n5a6f0edb8c.why: Large nuclear construction contracts are multi-year industrial projects that benefit reactor designers, engineering firms and their supply chains.

n2375efb7ce.headline: Ukraine and the US have finally signed a minerals deal. What does it include?
n2375efb7ce.summary: The United States and Ukraine have signed a deal expected to give Washington access to Ukraine's critical minerals and other natural resources. The agreement followed months of tense negotiations.
n2375efb7ce.why: Access to critical minerals such as lithium and rare earths affects supply chains for batteries, electronics and defence manufacturing.

n3fafcdd1e5.headline: US prepares to authorize weapons sale to Ukraine following minerals deal
n3fafcdd1e5.summary: The United States is preparing to authorise a weapons sale to Ukraine, following the new rare minerals deal between the two countries. Details of the sale were not provided.
n3fafcdd1e5.why: Arms sales and defence spending shape demand for defence contractors and affect the geopolitical outlook for the region.

na71c9899c3.headline: EU Won’t Extend Duty-Free Deal With Ukraine in June, EU Commission Confirms
na71c9899c3.summary: The European Commission confirmed the EU will not extend the duty-free arrangement with Ukraine in June. Trade will shift to liberalization under Article 29 of the Association Agreement.
na71c9899c3.why: Tariff and quota arrangements under the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement shape Ukrainian exports and the cost of EU imports of Ukrainian agricultural and industrial goods.

n8c786ff65f.headline: Saudi Arabia Pushes Owners of White Land to Revive Properties, Boost Supply
n8c786ff65f.summary: The Saudi Cabinet amended the White Land Tax system to encourage landowners to develop properties. Real estate experts said the change could increase residential supply and balance the property market.
n8c786ff65f.why: The white land tax penalises undeveloped urban land, and changes to it affect housing supply, real estate valuations, and developer activity in Saudi Arabia.

n46b337df45.headline: Bank of Japan keeps rates steady, cuts growth forecasts on US tariff hit
n46b337df45.summary: The Bank of Japan kept interest rates unchanged and cut its growth forecasts, citing the impact of US tariffs. It expects underlying consumer inflation to reach its 2% target around the latter half of fiscal 2026.
n46b337df45.why: The Bank of Japan sets monetary policy for the world's fourth-largest economy, and its rate path drives yen moves, Japanese equities, and global carry trades.
n46b337df45.why_moved: The central bank held rates steady and lowered its growth outlook because of the hit from US tariffs, while still expecting inflation to approach its 2% target.

nb07d23a3ba.headline: U.S. economy shrinks in the 1st quarter. And, Ukraine and the U.S. sign minerals deal
nb07d23a3ba.summary: The U.S. economy shrank during the first three months of the year, and consumer confidence has fallen sharply. Separately, Ukraine and the U.S. signed a minerals deal that both sides call a win.
nb07d23a3ba.why: Quarterly GDP is the broadest measure of U.S. economic output, and contraction readings shape expectations for Federal Reserve policy and corporate earnings. Consumer confidence signals household spending, which drives a large share of U.S. growth.
nb07d23a3ba.why_moved: A first-quarter contraction and a sharp drop in consumer confidence weigh on growth expectations, which typically pressures equities and shifts rate expectations.

n1bf5d0ac78.headline: Mobile-health Network Solutions Intends To Acquire Lifepack, Expanding into Indonesia’s Growing Healthcare Market
n1bf5d0ac78.summary: Nasdaq-listed Mobile-health Network Solutions intends to acquire Lifepack, expanding into Indonesia's healthcare market, according to a company announcement dated April 30, 2025.
n1bf5d0ac78.why: Acquisitions of regional healthcare businesses let listed MedTech firms enter faster-growing markets without building operations from scratch.

neae0dfdd3e.headline: Senate summons Lafarge Africa Plc over planned divestment of 83.8% shares
neae0dfdd3e.summary: The Senate Committee on Capital Market resolved to summon Lafarge Africa Plc over its planned divestment of an 83.8% majority shareholding.
neae0dfdd3e.why: Lafarge Africa is a Nigerian cement producer, and large majority-stake sales can reshape ownership and governance of listed companies.

n0ab7cf50c4.headline: Trump threatens sanctions against buyers of Iranian oil after US-Iran nuclear talks are postponed
n0ab7cf50c4.summary: President Donald Trump threatened sanctions on anyone buying Iranian oil, a warning issued after planned talks over Tehran's rapidly advancing nuclear program were postponed.
n0ab7cf50c4.why: Iran is a significant crude exporter, so sanctions on its oil buyers can tighten global supply and affect oil prices.
n0ab7cf50c4.why_moved: Threatened sanctions on buyers of Iranian oil raise the prospect of lower Iranian crude supply, while the postponement of nuclear talks adds geopolitical uncertainty.

ne950f1bfb6.headline: Aerolíneas Argentinas announces it won’t need state funding in 2025
ne950f1bfb6.summary: The Argentine flag carrier said it will not require state funding in 2025. The airline has been subject to contested privatization attempts since President Javier Milei took office.
ne950f1bfb6.why: Aerolíneas Argentinas is the state-owned flag carrier of Argentina. Its funding needs and privatization status affect public finances and airline sector investors.

n77cbfee4fe.headline: Trump's Treasury Department Targets Mexican Cartels Trafficking Fentanyl, Stolen Fuel
n77cbfee4fe.summary: The US Treasury's OFAC imposed sanctions on three Mexican nationals and two Mexico-based entities allegedly linked to a drug trafficking and fuel theft network tied to CJNG.
n77cbfee4fe.why: OFAC sanctions freeze assets and bar US persons from dealings with listed parties, which can disrupt financial flows and cross-border business with sanctioned targets.

n7a59d8b0e8.headline: Rio Tinto investors reject call to drop primary London listing
n7a59d8b0e8.summary: More than 80% of votes cast at Rio Tinto's annual general meeting were against a proposal from Palliser Capital to drop its primary London listing.
n7a59d8b0e8.why: Rio Tinto is a global mining group whose listing venue affects its share register, valuation and access to investors.

impacts.why: Shareholders voted down a proposal that would have removed its primary London listing.

n6783942fef.headline: US dollar rallies on continued trade deal optimism; yen slumps
n6783942fef.summary: The US dollar continued to bounce back after being oversold last month, with investors more optimistic about tariff deals between the United States and trading partners.
n6783942fef.why: The dollar is the world's main reserve currency, and its moves affect global trade pricing, capital flows and emerging market debt.
n6783942fef.why_moved: Investors grew more optimistic about tariff deals, prompting technical buying in the dollar after a prior oversold period.

ne53540ff00.headline: Trump-linked stablecoin used for Abu Dhabi’s US$2 billion Binance deal
ne53540ff00.summary: World Liberty Financial said its new stablecoin is being used for a $2 billion investment in crypto exchange Binance Holdings by Abu Dhabi's investor.
ne53540ff00.why: Binance is one of the largest global crypto exchanges, and stablecoins are used to settle digital asset transactions.

na7f9d2e2ab.headline: ATI Announces First Quarter 2025 Results
na7f9d2e2ab.summary: ATI reported strong year-over-year sales growth driven by aerospace and defense, with those sales reaching $754 million, or 66% of first-quarter 2025 sales.
na7f9d2e2ab.why: ATI is a specialty materials producer serving aerospace, defense and energy markets.

n69197f39e7.headline: Increased corn acres driving higher fertilizer prices; farmers may see fuel price relief
n69197f39e7.summary: Economists at the University of Arkansas System Division of Agriculture say higher fertilizer prices in the Mid-South are driven more by demand from increased corn acres than by tariffs. Farmers may see fuel price relief.
n69197f39e7.why: Fertilizer is a major input cost for grain producers, so its price affects farm margins and crop economics.

n444602805f.headline: A flood twice the size of the UK and a long road ahead
n444602805f.summary: Floods have devastated Outback Queensland, submerging land twice the size of the UK, and farmers face heavy losses and a long recovery.
n444602805f.why: Queensland's outback grazing and cropping sector supplies beef and agricultural produce, so prolonged flood damage can affect farm output and regional supply.

n1832d45dd1.headline: Gold Rates jump Rs20,800 in April 2025, Where will bullion stop this year?
n1832d45dd1.summary: Gold rates in Pakistan climbed by Rs20,800 in April 2025, according to the Pakistan Observer. First-quarter 2025 saw about Rs70,000 in increases amid record buying.
n1832d45dd1.why: Gold is a traditional store of value and a key hedge against currency weakness, and local gold prices in major importing markets reflect both global bullion moves and domestic currency changes.

na7f00e7fa3.headline: Big Tech’s fortunes diverge as AI powers cloud, tariffs hit consumer electronics
na7f00e7fa3.summary: Big Tech's fortunes are diverging as demand for artificial intelligence fuels growth in cloud and digital ads. Consumer electronics are being hit by tariffs.
na7f00e7fa3.why: Large technology platforms drive index weightings, and AI-driven cloud demand is a key earnings driver for investors.

n12540c8e5b.headline: Trump's VA strands thousands of veterans by ending a key mortgage program
n12540c8e5b.summary: The VA Servicing Purchase program has helped about 20,000 veterans avoid foreclosure. Trump's VA is ending the program, which Republicans in Congress have criticised as risking taxpayer money.
n12540c8e5b.why: Federal housing programs affect mortgage servicers, housing finance and taxpayer exposure to loan losses.

n677446000f.headline: Andy Jassy: we’re continuing to find meaningful ways to make customers’ lives easier
n677446000f.summary: Amazon.com has announced financial results for its first quarter ended March 31, 2025. CEO Andy Jassy said the company is continuing to find ways to make customers' lives easier.
n677446000f.why: Amazon is one of the largest companies in the world, spanning e-commerce, cloud computing through AWS, and advertising. Its quarterly results are closely watched as a read on consumer spending and corporate technology demand.

impacts.name: Amazon
impacts.why: Quarterly results report on Amazon's first-quarter 2025 performance.

n13c9561e3f.headline: India's economy to grow 6.6% in FY26 amid global trade challenges: Deloitte
n13c9561e3f.summary: Deloitte projects India's economy to grow 6.6% in FY26, balancing domestic stimulus against global trade challenges. Tax cuts are expected to support consumption.
n13c9561e3f.why: Deloitte is a major professional services firm whose macroeconomic forecasts are widely cited by investors and policymakers.

n249e7c5d4f.headline: NYC budget: Mayor Adams unveils $115 billion re-election year plan flush with new spending
n249e7c5d4f.summary: Mayor Eric Adams unveiled a $115 billion executive budget for the coming fiscal year, with substantial new spending. The plan comes as he faces a steep re-election challenge.
n249e7c5d4f.why: New York City's budget sets public spending and tax-funded services for one of the largest municipal economies in the US, influencing municipal bond credit.

n388678f343.headline: Morgan Stanley to Launch Crypto Trading via E*Trade in 2026
n388678f343.summary: Morgan Stanley is set to introduce crypto trading on its E*Trade platform in 2026, offering mainstream access to digital assets. The move extends the bank's digital asset offering to retail clients.
n388678f343.why: Morgan Stanley is a major US investment bank, and its expansion into crypto trading signals growing mainstream integration of digital assets with traditional brokerage.

n4688036e35.headline: Stocks close sharply higher, lifted by Microsoft, Meta earnings
n4688036e35.summary: The Dow and S&P 500 posted their eighth straight session of gains after strong results from Microsoft and Meta eased concerns about artificial intelligence spending.
n4688036e35.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 of the largest US-listed companies, and Microsoft and Meta are among the biggest weights in it, so their results move the index.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The benchmark index rose on a broad rally led by megacap technology earnings.

nfcf02e64d1.headline: OPEC Plot Twist? Bloomberg Survey Shows Production Drop in April
nfcf02e64d1.summary: Instead of raising output as planned, OPEC's April production dropped by 200,000 barrels per day to 27.24 million bpd, according to a Bloomberg survey published on Thursday.
nfcf02e64d1.why: OPEC coordinates production among major oil exporters, and changes in its output shape global crude supply and Brent prices.
nfcf02e64d1.why_moved: A reported drop in OPEC production, rather than the planned increase, changes the expected supply outlook for crude oil.

n485e111191.headline: Govt to review restoration of PDS wheat  supply after procurement ends
n485e111191.summary: The Indian government will review restoring wheat entitlements under the Public Distribution System after the ongoing procurement drive concludes. The agriculture ministry has projected a record harvest.
n485e111191.why: India is one of the world's largest wheat producers, and its public distribution and procurement policies influence domestic food prices and global grain markets.

impacts.name: Wheat
impacts.why: Policy on wheat distribution and procurement affects domestic wheat supply and demand.

n2858be1396.headline: M&S hit by Percy Pig shortage following cyber attack as shoppers left in shock
n2858be1396.summary: M&S stores have empty shelves following a recent cyber attack, with Percy Pigs among the affected products. The retailer has not been restocked on these lines according to the report.
n2858be1396.why: Marks & Spencer is a major UK retailer, and cyber attacks that disrupt stock and operations can affect sales and costs.

n24f8e965b3.headline: Q&M Dental makes cash offer for remaining Aoxin Q&M shares at S$0.0321 each
n24f8e965b3.summary: Q&M Dental has made a cash offer at S$0.0321 per share for the remaining Aoxin Q&M shares. The acquisition is being made through a security enforcement and aligns with its asset and earnings expansion strategy.
n24f8e965b3.why: Cash offers for remaining minority shares can lead to delisting or consolidation of control, affecting minority shareholders.

n15904b2072.headline: Hiscox maintains wildfire reserve levels while Retail and Re & ILS advance
n15904b2072.summary: Hiscox has maintained its wildfire reserve levels while its Retail and Re and ILS businesses advance. New construction, marine and specialty placements offset softening casualty rates.
n15904b2072.why: Hiscox is a London-based specialty insurer, and reserve levels and pricing trends affect its profitability and capital position.

n7d8aa341f9.headline: Bank of Japan keeps rates steady, lowers growth forecasts
n7d8aa341f9.summary: The Bank of Japan kept interest rates unchanged on Thursday and revised down its growth forecasts for this year and next. It warned that trade tariffs are weighing on the outlook.
n7d8aa341f9.why: The Bank of Japan sets the country's policy rate, which influences yen exchange rates, Japanese government bond yields and equity valuations.
n7d8aa341f9.why_moved: The central bank kept rates on hold while cutting its growth outlook, citing the impact of trade tariffs.

n76ac1e4eef.headline: US, Ukraine sign agreement for decade-long military aid
n76ac1e4eef.summary: The United States signed an agreement to invest long-term in Ukraine, ensuring military aid will flow to the country for the next decade. The deal was described as a long-term commitment.
n76ac1e4eef.why: Long-term military financing shapes the outlook for Ukraine's war-related spending and the wider geopolitical and defence-industry landscape.

n6ecd76a8af.headline: Ukraine and US have finally signed  minerals deal. What does it include
n6ecd76a8af.summary: The US and Ukraine have signed a deal expected to give Washington access to Ukraine's critical minerals and other natural resources. Kyiv hopes it will secure long-term support.
n6ecd76a8af.why: Critical minerals are inputs for batteries, electronics and defence products, so access agreements shape supply chains and geopolitical alignment.

nefcf4e3bc6.headline: South Korea Inflation Flat in April, Possibly Paving Way for Policy Easing -- Update
nefcf4e3bc6.summary: South Korea's headline inflation was flat in April, possibly allowing the central bank to loosen monetary policy further to support a sagging economy. The benchmark rate was not detailed in the input.
nefcf4e3bc6.why: Inflation readings guide the Bank of Korea's interest rate decisions, which affect the won, Korean bond yields and equities.

nf542344810.summary: Microsoft and Meta Platforms led Wall Street higher after reporting start-of-year profits bigger than analysts expected. The S&P 500 rose 0.6% on the day.
nf542344810.why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark for large US companies, and Microsoft and Meta are among its largest technology constituents.

n70945f57ca.headline: Nvidia RTX 50-series GPU prices drop below MSRP in Germany as demand wanes
n70945f57ca.summary: Demand for Nvidia's RTX 50-series graphics cards is falling across Germany, with most models now selling at or below manufacturer-suggested retail prices.
n70945f57ca.why: Nvidia designs graphics processors widely used in gaming, data centres and AI, so consumer GPU pricing offers a read on demand for its products.

n4cc5d00af6.summary: Microsoft and Meta Platforms drove Wall Street higher after reporting profits for the start of the year that exceeded analyst expectations.
n4cc5d00af6.why: Microsoft and Meta are among the largest US technology companies, and their earnings heavily influence major US equity indexes.

nd42571cde6.headline: Meiji, Lactalis, Saputo, Warburg may bid in Fonterra's $2.4 billion sale, sources say
nd42571cde6.summary: Meiji, Lactalis, Saputo and Warburg are considering bids for business units that Fonterra is seeking to divest in a sale valued at $2.4 billion, sources said.
nd42571cde6.why: Fonterra is New Zealand's largest dairy cooperative, and its divestments affect global dairy supply and the buyers involved.

n42c01110cf.headline: Nordic partnership to fast-track SMR deployment
n42c01110cf.summary: Swedish nuclear company Blykalla and Norway's Institute for Energy Technology agreed a strategic collaboration to accelerate the deployment of small modular reactors.
n42c01110cf.why: Small modular reactors are compact nuclear units seen as a way to add low-carbon power, and partnerships like this shape how quickly they reach market.

nbf1c996e8c.headline: Lactalis, Saputo among parties ‘eyeing up Fonterra’s up-for-sale dairy assets’
nbf1c996e8c.summary: Global dairy groups Lactalis and Saputo are reportedly interested in acquiring the consumer-facing assets of New Zealand's Fonterra, which are up for sale.
nbf1c996e8c.why: Fonterra is New Zealand's largest dairy exporter, and consumer dairy brands are a sizable part of global dairy markets where Lactalis and Saputo are major players.

nef1efc2c12.headline: McDonald's loses US diners as they 'grapple with uncertainty'
nef1efc2c12.summary: McDonald's said its US customers are 'grappling with uncertainty', and the burger chain has lost diners in the country. The company's comments point to weaker consumer demand.
nef1efc2c12.why: McDonald's is one of the largest global restaurant chains, and its US traffic is a key gauge of American consumer spending.

nbec168ed1a.headline: Lactalis, Saputo among parties ‘eyeing up Fonterra’s up-for-sale dairy assets’
nbec168ed1a.summary: Lactalis and Saputo are reportedly among parties eyeing Fonterra's up-for-sale dairy assets. Japan's Meiji and Warburg Pincus are also said to be weighing bids for the consumer-facing business.
nbec168ed1a.why: Fonterra is a major New Zealand dairy cooperative, and sales of its assets would reshape global dairy supply and consumer brand ownership.

n184dd5d95c.headline: Trade war injects note of uncertainty into CN Rail outlook, as profits climb
n184dd5d95c.summary: Canadian National Railway's profits rose in its latest quarter, but uncertainty grew as the trade war set off by US President Donald Trump weighed on its outlook. Its results reflect the country's largest railroad operator.
n184dd5d95c.why: Canadian National is a major North American freight railway, so its volumes and outlook are sensitive to cross-border trade with the United States.

n859917b335.headline: Canadian Dollar Climbs Against Most Majors
n859917b335.summary: The Canadian dollar strengthened against most major currencies in Thursday's Asian session, rising to more than three-week highs against the yen.
n859917b335.why: The Canadian dollar is sensitive to commodity prices and interest rate expectations, which affect Canadian exporters and investors.
